integrity: Mathematical derivation and exact reproducibility checks are supplied; the central limit is analytic, not extrapolated from finite enumeration.
limitations: No dynamical circuit conclusions; no result for noisy, periodic or arbitrary graph states.
Previously published finite-size one-dimensional cluster-state histograms require credit; priority beyond inspected full text remains uncertain.
scientific_scope: Exact balanced-bipartition von Neumann entropy law of open-path pure qubit graph states of even length at least four; Gaussian asymptotics for the number of sites tending to infinity.
title: Balanced-cut entanglement of linear cluster states: exact law and Gaussian limit
